maya: Quick thought — we should add a "withdraw" / "revert" operation for runtime configs so ops can roll a flag back to a previous snapshot at cohort granularity instead of flipping global. Low-risk UX + audit. Thoughts?
liam: +1. Very useful when a canary shows degradation. What's the proposed API shape?
ana: fyi I mean ana (typo)
maya: example payload sketch: ```json
{
  \"action\": \"withdraw\",
  \"target\": { \"flag_id\": \"enable-new-routing\", \"scope\": \"cohort:beta-12\" },
  \"snapshot_id\": \"snap-2026-03-18-1740\",
  \"dry_run\": true,
  \"reason\": \"regression in p99 for cohort\"
}
```
ana: I mean ana: prefer name `revert_to_snapshot` to avoid confusion with deleting. Also we should require `snapshot_id` (no implicit guess). :+1:
maya: agreed re: required snapshot_id. we should also emit telemetry event `config.revert` with {from, to, scope, actor, snapshot_id, dry_run} so we can track frequency + impact.
rija: ops concern — any revert that affects >20% traffic should auto-open an approval flow in console (owner + sec). otherwise easy accidental mass rollbacks. also add cooldown: no >50% withdraws within 30m. :eyes:
liam: safety question — what if the older snapshot references model variants that are no longer available? need compatibility checks and an automatic fallback policy (e.g., fail safe, or map to closest variant). Also dry_run should simulate result and surface diffs.
maya: yep compatibility checks + dry_run diff mask. also include an `allow_fallback` boolean. if false, revert fails and returns reason.
nana: ana again — I'll take console UX for the approval modal and rollout picker. fields: snapshot selector, scope (cohort/global), estimated impact (calc tokens/sec + % traffic), approver list, ttl for approval. will add a mock in Figma.
maya: who will own telemetry dashboards/alerts for these reverts? we need a metric to catch bad rollbacks (eg revert_success_rate, post-revert error spike).
rija: I can own telemetry. plan: add `revert_success_rate` and a short-term SLO: if p50 latency increases by >10% or error rate +5% within 5m of revert -> auto-trigger incident runbook and roll-forward. also warn on revert frequency spikes.
liam: can we add an API param `notify_on` to trigger extra hooks (pager, slack channel) for large reverts?
maya: yes — `notify_on: ["impact>5%","errors>3x"]` — console should let ops pick defaults per-team.
ops-bot: deploybot: Scheduled: config-service v2.14.1 will expose `revert_to_snapshot` endpoint at 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC. :robot_face:
nana: perfect — once deploy is live I'll wire UX. will add an approval flow mock and send here.
maya: I'll draft the runbook snippet and the API RFC tonight. liam — can you add the compatibility check to model onboarding checklist?
liam: yep will do, adding into onboarding PR.
maya: OK, next steps: ana owns console UX, rija telemetry + alerting, liam model compatibility + API impl, maya runs the RFC and runbook. i'll ping infra for rate-limiting knobs. thanks :thumbsup:
rija: noted, I'll create dashboard and a short alert playbook.
liam: will add unit tests for dry_run diffs.
maya: filing a tiny ticket to track approvals + cooldown config: https://redwood/issue/infra-rollback-123 (placeholder)
maya: thanks all — we'll sync in the weekly eng-platform meeting if any blockers.
